Class GameManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.gamemanager.GameManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
ApplicableActions, Snapshotable
Direct Known Subclasses:
RestoredGameManager
public class GameManager extends Object implements ApplicableActions, Snapshotable
Core model class for a single game session.

GameManager coordinates all game activity by implementing the State pattern: it holds a reference to the active GamePhaseState and delegates phase-specific logic to it. It also exposes the three player-driven entry points (onMoveRequested, onDrawCardRequested, onSkipRequested) through the ApplicableActions interface, which the Controller invokes after receiving and dispatching incoming network messages.

The raw game state (board, deck, players, current turn) is encapsulated in GameState; GameManager accesses it to apply transitions and delegate calculations, keeping phase logic separate from data structures.

Observers registered via GameNotifier are notified of every relevant state change so that connected clients can keep their views up to date.

Implements Snapshotable to support game persistence.

    • initGame

      public void initGame()
      Initializes the game state, broadcasts the initial board to all observers, and fires the game-started callback if one has been registered.

    • nextPhase

      public void nextPhase()
      Advances the game to the next phase as determined by the current GamePhaseState. If the phase actually changes, observers are notified and the new phase's onEntry hook is invoked.

    • changeAge

      public void changeAge()
      Increments the current age, updates card lists accordingly, and notifies all observers of the age change.

    • loadSkippableDraws

      public void loadSkippableDraws()
      Loads skippable draw actions for the first player that has pending ones. If such a player is found, sets that player as current and notifies observers about the available draw options.

    • refillBoard

      public void refillBoard()
      Refills the board with new cards from the deck. If cards belonging to a newer age are drawn during the refill, changeAge() is called.

      public void onMoveRequested(String nick, int tilePos) throws OccupiedTileException, InvalidPhaseException, InvalidPlayerException, InvalidMoveException
      Handles a player's request to move their token to a board tile.
      Specified by:
      onMoveRequested in interface ApplicableActions
      Parameters:
      nick - the nickname of the requesting player
      tilePos - the index of the target tile on the board
      Throws:
      InvalidPhaseException - if the game is not in SETUP_PHASE
      InvalidPlayerException - if nick is not the current player
      InvalidMoveException - if tilePos does not correspond to a valid tile
      OccupiedTileException - if the target tile is already occupied
